bot.welcome:
👋 Hi {name}! I send you fresh computer-science jobs in Bangladesh and remote jobs open to Bangladesh, each scored against your profile.

Setting up takes about a minute. What I keep about you, and why: /privacy.
bot.welcome_back: 👋 Welcome back, {name}! You're all set: /settings changes your preferences and /help lists everything I can do.

steps.tracks: 1/7 · Tracks Which career tracks do you want jobs from? Tap to select, then Next.
steps.refine: Refine your tracks Untick any area you don't want. Jobs in ticked areas still reach you.
steps.level: 2/7 · Experience Where are you in your career?
steps.where: 3/7 · Where Where can you work? Pick one or both.
steps.cities: Preferred cities (optional) Jobs in these cities score a little higher; jobs elsewhere in Bangladesh still reach you.
steps.job_types: 4/7 · Job types Which kinds of jobs do you want?
steps.skills: 5/7 · Skills Type your skills separated by commas (for example: Python, SQL, React), send your CV as a PDF, or skip for now.
steps.score: 6/7 · Match strictness Only send jobs that score at least…
steps.delivery: 7/7 · Delivery Each match as soon as it's found, or once a day?
steps.quiet: Quiet hours (optional) No alerts during these hours ({zone} time). They wait until the hours end.

bot.privacy: Privacy I store your Telegram id, name and username, your settings and skills, and the jobs I matched for you with their scores, only to send you matching jobs. Job postings are read by AI services (Google Gemini, Groq) to extract their facts. Your own data is never sent to them, except a CV you choose to send (its text goes only to Groq, which doesn't keep or train on it, and is deleted once read) and, for a weekly check that the scores are right, your settings and skills without your name or id, also only to Groq. Your data is never sold or shared. /export downloads it and /delete removes all of it.
bot.delete_confirm: Delete all your data? Your settings, skills, matches and feedback are removed for good. You can start again any time with /start.
